5.title: Offer expiry enforcement
5.body: **User story** — As a shopper, expired offers never apply to my cart.
5.author: paul

comments.author: paul
comments.body:
**[product] · Q6 · expiry while the cart is open**

When an offer expires after it was added to an open cart, is it
- (a) excluded at checkout — strict, R4 as written ← ✅ recommended
- (b) honoured if it was valid when it was added

*why: R4 says when an offer counts, not when "added" is measured; (a)/(b) decides whether the cart needs to remember when a line was added.*
*raised by the fold of Q3*

comments.author: paul
comments.body: (b) — 加入購物車時還有效就算數,結帳時不要把它拿掉。
